claims.value: BM06, BM09, BM10, AT06, AT10, AT11
claims.evidence: PRIDE processing protocol: RAW named BM6,9,10 and AT6,10,11 (n=3 biological replicates). Names are the file stems.
PRIDE organism NEWT:9796; paper: equine MSCs.
PRIDE protocol: AT-MSC from adipose tissue, BM-MSC from sternal bone marrow aspirates; file prefix gives the origin.
Title and protocol: equine mesenchymal stem (stromal) cells expanded to passage 3.
Six distinct samples. The paper says cells came from three horses (1-3) but no file-to-horse map is deposited, so each sample is its own replicate number.
Paper: donors were mares aged 13 to 17 years (inferred adult).
Paper: cells obtained from mares.
Paper: mares of mixed breeds, approx. 500 kg.
Horses were euthanized for unrelated reasons; no disease status stated, so no claim is made.
The study contrasts BM-MSC and AT-MSC surface proteomes.
Paper: Q Exactive HF; AT06.raw header strings 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'. PRIDE dropdown says Q Exactive (MS:1001911), overridden by the paper and RAW header.
Method file name in RAW header: Nano75_Top20_30min_r30kv1; paper: up to 20 precursors per MS1 scan (Top20 DDA). Value written is DDA PRIDE:0000627.
Paper: in-gel trypsin digestion; MaxQuant enzyme Trypsin/P, max 2 missed cleavages.

parameters.txt MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm.
parameters.txt does not record the precursor tolerance (MaxQuant defaults not written).
Not stated in the deposit or the paper methods; not inferred.
PRIDE quantification: spectrum counting; MaxQuant LFQ, multiplicity 1.
One excised gel band per sample, one injection.
